{{nihongo|'''Shiitori Shrine'''|椎取神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Shiitori Shrine''' (しいとりじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} on {{ill|Miyake-jima|Q1075076|qid=Q1075076}} in {{ill|Miyake, Tokyo|Q1154797|qid=Q1154797}}, {{ill|Tokyo|Q1490|qid=Q1490}}.

It is enshrined in northeastern Miyake-jima along Metropolitan Route 212 (the island loop road).

It is identified with '''Shiritagi Shrine''' (しりたきじんじゃ), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}<ref name="kanko">[https://www.miyakejima.gr.jp/see/shiitorijinja/ 椎取神社] - Miyakejima Tourism Association</ref><ref name="official">[https://miyakejima-jinja.jimdofree.com/ 三宅島の神社 (富賀神社・御笏神社・椎取神社 他)]</ref>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Shiritagi-no-Mikoto (しりたきのみこと) - identified as "Shitai," the fifth child among the eight princes born between {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi|Q8009611|qid=Q8009611}} (Mishima Daimyōjin) and his consort Sakitamahime-no-Mikoto (deity of {{ill|Oshaku Shrine|Q110915859|qid=Q110915859}})<ref name="official"/>.

=== Former shrine building ===
Just south of the current torii and shrine building are the old torii and old shrine building, but they were buried by mudflow during the {{ill|Miyake-jima|Q1075076|qid=Q1075076|lt=2000 eruption (Heisei 12)}}, so the present torii and shrine building were constructed just to the north<ref name="kanko"/>.
